title: Guy Next Door
synopsis: Lila Harper's quiet life takes an unexpected turn when Darius Kane, a tall, dangerously charming stranger, moves in next door. What begins as innocent flirting quickly ignites into an irresistible attraction neither can ignore. But just as Lila begins to fall for her mysterious neighbor, secrets from Darius's past threaten to destroy their growing connection. With jealousy, temptation, and trust on the line, will their chemistry lead to lasting love—or heartbreak?
author: LokkeeVerse
